**How to falsify it:** The presence of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in MECP2 with allele frequencies greater than 0.001 in gnomAD across all populations would refute the causal link. _(variant: HGNC:6990)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism involving MECP2 provides a common target for therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring proper neuronal gene expression and development in both intellectual disability and neonatal encephalopathy.
